_sr.htmlstr: Iji Kiyura Division: Distribution 0.9   Tunttaras IX - Moon 11 - Ytiri Storage Effective Standing: 0.0 Rancorous Researcher (1 of 5) My stupid lab assistant has managed to trigger the security protocols in one of my research areas, and now he s stuck in there. He s just lucky he managed to get off a brief call for help, because as it happens, the lockdown procedure includes jamming all long-distance communications. I need you to go pick up one of my data chips. I m storing them at another station; I ll let them know to leave one in your hangar. I can explain more after you bring it to me. Declining a mission from a particular agent more than once every 4 hours may result in a loss of standing with that agent, except in the case of special missions that clearly state otherwise in their description.

Rancorous Researcher (1 of 5) Objectives The following objectives must be completed to finish the mission: Transport Objective Transport these goods: Pickup Location 0.8   Nourvukaiken VI - Moon 2 - State and Region Bank Depository Drop-off Location 0.9   Tunttaras IX - Moon 11 - Ytiri Storage Cargo 1 x Encoded Data Chip (0.1 m ) Rewards The following rewards will be yours if you complete this mission: 1 x Device 24 Loyalty Points Bonus Rewards The following rewards will be awarded to you as a bonus if you complete the mission within 58 minutes: 21,000 ISK
